from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Optional
from mashumaro import DataClassDictMixin, field_options
@dataclass
class Child(DataClassDictMixin):
    x: int
@dataclass
class Parent(DataClassDictMixin):
    child: Optional[Child] = field(default=None, metadata=field_options(flatten=True))
assert Parent(Child(1)).to_dict() == {'x': 1}
assert Parent.from_dict({'x': 1}) == Parent(Child(1))
assert Parent.from_dict({}) == Parent()
print('flatten reproduction passes')
